title: Allowance Settled Against a Granite Ridge Retained Charge for the Season Still to Come
content:
How much of the season still remains on the handling date settles an allowance against the charge retained when a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass is given up.

Where at least two thirds of the season's days still remain on the handling date, an allowance of 25.00 is settled against the charge. Where at least a third but fewer than two thirds of the season's days still remain on the handling date, an allowance of 12.50 is settled against it. In any other case no allowance is settled against it by this rule.

The days still to come are counted from the handling date to the day the season closes, and they are set against the days of the season itself, counted from the day it opened to the day it closes. On a season running from 2026-11-20 to 2027-04-18 that is 149 days, so two thirds still remain while 100 days or more are left and a third still remains while 50 days or more are left: at 100 days left the allowance is 25.00, at 99 it is 12.50, at 50 it is 12.50, and at 49 no allowance is settled by this rule.

The allowance is a figure in USD settled against the charge, not a percentage of it, and the same two figures of 25.00 and 12.50 apply whatever the tier.

Worked on a hypothetical handling date: a pass given up on 1 February on a season closing on 2027-04-18. Seventy-six days of the season are still to come, which is above the third mark of 50 and below the two thirds mark of 100, so 12.50 is settled against the charge.
